# GitHub Copilot Instructions

GitHub Copilot must strictly follow the shared repository guidelines defined in:
- `AGENTS.md`
- `.agents/rules/core-standards.md`
- `.agents/rules/architecture-and-code.md`
- `.agents/rules/git-workflow.md`
- `.agents/rules/security-and-safety.md`

All code, documentation, and file outputs must remain in English.
